title: ALMA Imaging of the CO (7-6) Line Emission in the Submillimeter Galaxy LESS 073 at z = 4.755
question: What are the CO(7-6) line, [CI] and continuum properties of SMG LESS 073 at z=4.755, and can line-ratio-based f60/f100 estimates be validated against SED fits?

data.sensitivity: 0.3 mJy/beam per 100 km/s channel; continuum 40 uJy/beam

what.value: FIR/submm photometric points for the SED

evidence.quote: the remained photometric points are collected from the literature (De Breuck et al. 2014; Gilli et al. 2014 and see references therein)

external_data.citation: De Breuck et al. 2014; Gilli et al. 2014

what.value: [CII] and [NII] line fluxes for line ratios

evidence.quote: Reference for line (excluding CO (7$-$6)) fluxes: (1) De Breuck et al. (2014); (2) Nagao et al. (2012); (3) this work.

external_data.citation: De Breuck et al. 2014; Nagao et al. 2012

evidence.quote: Comparing our $L^\prime _{\rm CO\,(7-6)}$ with $L^\prime _{\rm CO\,(2-1)}$ from Coppin et al. (2010)

recipe.method: Combine calibrated data, clean with Briggs weighting; continuum from SPWs 0-3 excluding line channels; cube from SPW-0 binned to 100 km/s
Average of aperture photometry, 1-d Gaussian spectrum fit, and imfit 2-d fit
Single-temperature modified blackbody, optically thick vs thin
[CI] luminosity times conversion 12.5 Msun/(K km/s pc2); average with CO(2-1) based mass
Lu15 relations; SFR from CO(7-6), [NII], FIR; depletion time = Mgas/SFR

evidence.quote: integrated flux of $0.86\pm0.08$ Jy km s$^{-1}$
a line width of $343\pm40$ km s$^{-1}$
the flux density of the continuum is $0.51\pm0.02$ mJy

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels and continuum channel selection
Clean mask, threshold, cell and image size
Which SED photometric points and values were used
Which flux density exactly for the rest-frame 850 um gas mass
Primary beam and aperture spectrum extraction region details
Equation parameters for SFR from Lu15 not given
missing_for_reproduction: Imaging details (mask, cell size, line-free channels)
score_reason: Public data and basic imaging stated, but SED inputs and several imaging details missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, short dataset, numeric line flux and continuum results reproducible.
